Brasil 1275, interior 66-A, Jesús María (http://thecubegirls.com/index.php/tiendas). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago con el organizador, Alexander Esquivel CEL: 982527214. El registro permanecerá abierto mientras no se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 02 de febrero.

Подача заявки и оплата взноса за участие или входного билета гостя/зрителя означает, что Вы ознакомлены и согласны с правилами проведения чемпионата Если вы ознакомились с условиями регистрации и условиями оплаты взноса на вкладке "Как оплатить участие (Payment information)", то вы можете перейти к регистрации. ВНИМАНИЕ!!! 1. Если участник приходит без совершеннолетнего сопровождающего, то он обязан при себе иметь письменное заявление-согласие от родителей либо опекунов, о том, что они самостоятельно несут ответственность за несовершеннолетнего ребенка. 2. Головоломки используемые в соревнованиях должны иметь отличительные отметки, по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец (например: нацарапанные инициалы или имя с внутренней стороны съемной крышки) ====================================================== После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1-2 недели до соревнований вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и спам. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). В день соревнований участнику и гостю при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. For more info please visit our [VK Group](https://vk.com/ksfustkamenogorskcity2019). Before submitting the application, read the registration information. Registration with incorrect first and last name will not be accepted, please carefully check the entered data. Submitting an application and paying a participation fee or a guest / viewer entrance ticket means that you acquainted and agree with the rules of the championship If you have read the terms of registration and the terms of payment of the fee in the tab "How to pay / How to pay for participation", then you can proceed to registration. **ATTENTION!!! 1. If a participant under 18 years old attends the competition without adult, he must have written application from parents or legal guardians that they are responsible for their child. 2. Puzzles used in competitions must have distinctive marks by which the owner can easily identify them (for example, scratched initials or the name on the inside of the removable cover) ** After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you did not pay the fee, then approximately 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email with a reminder to pay a fee to confirm your participation. Be sure to check your box and spam. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but it was not confirmed within 2 business days, contact the organizers immediately (not counting the weekend). On the day of the competition, the participant and the guest need to have an identity document.

items.information: Autrian Open 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other related puzzles as quickly as possible. items.name: Swisscubing Better Be Quick 2018
items.information: Pendant la pause de midi, nous allons faire des grillades. Nous comptons donc sur tous les compétiteurs d'apporter des salades, viandes ou autre (le top étant des spécialités de sa propre région) afin de le partager avec les autres compétiteurs. During lunch time we will do a big BBQ, so we hope that everyone will bring some salads, meat and other meals (the best option would be to bring specialities from your own region) in aim to share it with everyone. Während der Mittagspause werden wir grillieren. Darum hoffen wir dass alle Teilnehmer etwas zu essen mitbringen (Salat, Fleisch, Spezialität von zuhause) um es mit den anderen zu Teilen. Mentre la pausa di mezzogiorno faremo una grigliata. Speriamo che tutti porteranno delle insalate, della carne o altre cose (il meglio sono le specialità del vostro paese) da condividere con i altri concorrenti.

items.information: This competition will take place on the 6th of June and it is the first competition ever in Heimaey! To get to the island you need to go with a ferry called Herjólfur. The harbor is called Landeyjahöfn and is ~2 hours away from Reykjavík. It is possible to take a bus from there. You can order tickets to the ferry here - https://www.seatours.is/ . You can check out booking.com or airbnb.com for information about hotels and other places to stay in over night. Our goal with the schedule is to have events that were not held at Icelandic nationals. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Þetta mót verður haldið 6. júni og er það fyrsta mótið á Heimaey frá upphafi! Til þess að komast á eyjuna þarft þú að fara með ferjunni Herjólfi. Hann er staðsettur í Landeyjahöfn og er u.þ.b. tveggja klukkustunda keyrsla frá Reykjavík til Landeyjahafnar. Hægt er að taka strætó á milli staða. Hér getur þú pantað miða í Herjólf - https://www.saeferdir.is/ferdir-i-bodi/vestmannaeyjar/ Þú getur kíkt á booking.com / airbnb.com fyrir upplýsingar um hótel eða aðra gistingu í Vestmannaeyjum.

items.information: Mind Games 2017 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill, but there is a competitor limit of 60 people (FMC will have a limit of 25 competitors), due to venue constraints. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: Indian Cube Challenge 2017

venue.name: [Primus Public School](http://www.primusschool.com)
venue.address: Primus School, Off. Sarjapur Road, Chikanayakanahalli Village, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560035

items.information: **Online registration ends on 17th October, 2017. On the spot registration is available. Visit registration and payment tab for details.** If you want to be a full-time volunteer mention it in the "Comment" section during registration. **First time participants** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA Step 2 - [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianCubeChallenge2017/register) for the competition Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the [payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianCubeChallenge2017#2477-registration-and-payment). **Other participants** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions Step 2 - [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianCubeChallenge2017/register) for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned) Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the [payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianCubeChallenge2017#2477-registration-and-payment). **Special Prizes** Under-8, under-10 & under-12! First time participants also get special prizes! Leave a WhatsApp message on +91 9052529279 if you have additional queries.
